name: Shipping Online Tracker for CTT
author: cordelimapt

sections.description:
Shipping Online Tracker for CTT is the definitive solution for WooCommerce stores in Portugal that use the CTT “Envios Online” portal (for users without a formal business contract).

This plugin was designed to simplify the workflow for manual shipments. It allows the store administrator to manage tracking codes with a change log and provides the end customer with an intuitive interface to track their order.

Key Features:

  • Strategic Shortcut: Direct button to the CTT Envios Online Portal within each order.
  • Tracking Management: Dedicated field to insert the object tracking code.
  • Shipping History: Automatic log of previously entered dates and codes.
  • Professional Customer Area: Tracking buttons in the order list and account details.
  • Automatic Emails: Inclusion of a visual tracking block in the “Order Completed” email.
  • HPOS Compatibility: Fully prepared for WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ctt-envios-online folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the .zip file through the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to any WooCommerce order and you will find the new “CTT Shipping” box in the right sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically generate shipping labels?

No. This plugin is focused on manual shipments (no-contract users), facilitating the organization of tracking codes and communication with the customer.

Does it work with the new WooCommerce database system (HPOS)?

Yes, the plugin is 100% compatible with High Performance Order Storage tables.

Does the customer receive the tracking code by email?

Yes, as soon as the order is marked as “Completed”, the tracking code and the direct link are automatically included in the email sent to the customer.
